evidence.detail: cleanup() deletes rows from low_price older than start of season or 1 month, whichever is sooner — exactly the 'dropping old data' the issue describes
cleanup(count) is called unconditionally every time prices are fetched — still present in current master

triage.fix_sketch: Remove the `cleanup(count)` call at price_grabber/price_grabber.py:34 from `fetch()`. The `cleanup()` function itself can stay dormant or be deleted. Note: issue comment warns about eventual archiving need for performance; deleting the call is the minimum change to stop data loss.
triage.notes: Risk is disk growth — low_price will accumulate all historic prices indefinitely. The issue author's own comment acknowledges this; an archiving strategy may be needed separately.
